name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.ExposedRoot.cover_pad_card
title: Cover pad: over a finite ring, for invertible M and any x, t exactly one u has x + M u = t, so x + M u with uniform u is uniform whatever x is
statement: Over a finite ring, if M * Minv = 1 and Minv * M = 1, then for all matrices x, t the type of matrices u with x + M * u = t has exactly one element (Nat.card = 1).
